description: Dynamic-name and keyword handling: IDENTIFIER('name')(args) and IDENTIFIER($var)(args) as dynamically named function calls; non-reserved keywords (session, number, rename, replace, put, filter) staying usable as identifiers and aliases while anchored uses stay intact; GROUP and TABLE rejected as bare identifiers / qualified-name parts (live-verified); GET over PARSE_JSON; and the body-less CREATE TABLE refusals (bare, TAG-only, CLUSTER BY-only are syntax errors while the same tails parse behind a column list). Converted 1:1 from expressions/IdentifierCallAndReservedWordTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_it(a INTEGER, b INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER AS $$ a + b $$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION speed_of_light() RETURNS INTEGER AS $$ 299792458 $$
CREATE TABLE gwords (id INTEGER, group VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE kw (session VARCHAR, number INTEGER, rename VARCHAR, replace VARCHAR)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE kw2 (n NUMBER(10, 2))
CREATE TAG IF NOT EXISTS key1
CREATE TAG IF NOT EXISTS key2
CREATE TABLE bare_clustered CLUSTER BY (n1, n2)
CREATE TABLE tagged (id INTEGER) TAG (key1='value_1', key2='value_2')
CREATE TABLE clustered (n1 INTEGER, n2 INTEGER) CLUSTER BY (n1, n2)
ALTER TABLE tagged ADD extra INTEGER
